name: weighbridge-ticket
title: Weighbridge ticket
for_each: select id,ticket_no from tickets where void_reason is null and weighed_at>=now()-interval '14 days' order by ticket_no

sections.title: Weights
sections.note: Check the fields your trade measurement rules and your customers require on a ticket before using this as your weighbridge record.
sections.sql: select gross_t gross_tonnes,tare_t tare_tonnes,net_t net_tonnes,case when stored_tare then 'stored tare' else 'weighed empty' end tare_method,max_gross_t truck_limit_tonnes from v_tickets where ticket_id=$1

sections.title: Charges
sections.sql: select price_per_t,cartage_per_t,value,case when cash then 'cash' else 'account' end payment,invoice_ref from v_tickets where ticket_id=$1

name: customer-statement
title: Loads to invoice
for_each: select id,code from customers where account order by code

sections.title: Customer
sections.sql: select code,name,email,phone from customers where id=$1

sections.title: Loads not yet invoiced
sections.sql: select ticket_no,day,job,product,net_t,price_per_t,cartage_per_t,value from v_tickets where customer_id=$1 and invoice_ref is null order by day,ticket_no

name: royalty-summary
title: Royalty summary
for_each: select id,code from sites where royalty_per_t is not null order by code

sections.title: Site
sections.sql: select code,name,royalty_payee,royalty_per_t from sites where id=$1

sections.title: Months
sections.note: Tonnes are from the weighbridge tickets. Check the rate against your royalty agreement.
sections.sql: select period,tonnes,amount,due,lodged_on,ref from v_royalties where site_id=$1 order by period desc

name: consent-report
title: Consent tonnes report
for_each: select id,code from sites order by code

sections.title: Tonnes by month
sections.sql: select to_char(date_trunc('month',day),'YYYY-MM') as month,count(*) loads,sum(net_t) tonnes from v_tickets where site_id=$1 and day>=current_date-365 group by date_trunc('month',day) order by 1
